description: Consent for previously implemented works to convert the basement storage rooms into a kitchen/dining room and to convert the front vaults into a WC and utility room, involving works to lower the basement floor level by approximately 430mm, extension of the ground to basement staircase, the removal of the basement spine wall and a basement wall enclosing the ground to basement staircase, works of partial underpinning, structural works to support the basement ceiling, works of damp proofing to the basement floor and tanking of the two vaults and the relocation of the kitchen from ground floor to basement, together with the removal of the ground floor spine wall, blocking up of the doorway between the hall and the ground floor front room, removal of the hallway decorated arch and structural works to support the ground floor ceiling in the main rooms and hallway and asscociated and consequential works.
